defects.description: The translation 'Если ни один... не поддерживает' (If none support) completely reverses the meaning of the source 'If any... do not support' (If at least one does not support).
defects.quote: Если ни один из перечисленных серверов имён не поддерживает DNSSEC

defects.description: The term 'авторитативные' is used instead of the required glossary equivalent 'авторитетный'.
Grammatical error: the word 'Конфигурация' is used in the nominative case instead of the required prepositional case ('конфигурации') after the preposition 'в'.
The word is bolded in the translation, but it is not bolded in the source text.
Redundant phrasing: 'записей обратной записи' literally translates to 'entries of the reverse record'.
The list is grammatically inconsistent; 'авторитетных корневых' is an adjective phrase lacking a noun, while the following item is a noun phrase.
